how: Coursera, edX and similar platforms offer free-to-audit online university courses to anyone in the Chicago area, including courses from Chicago-based universities.
The Heartland Pyrotechnic Arts Association, a Midwest hobbyist and professional fireworks club, runs members-only and some open shoots in the region, while consumer fireworks are illegal in Illinois.
No glaciers in the Midwest; the nearest glacier trekking is in Glacier National Park, Montana, or the Canadian Rockies, a 3-4 hour flight away.
No volcanoes in the region; volcano boarding is done on Cerro Negro in Nicaragua, a roughly 5-hour flight away.
Bullfighting is not practised in Illinois and is banned under animal cruelty law; the nearest bullrings are in Mexico, a roughly 4-hour flight away.
